title.en: A welcome from a new neighbor

objective.fa: تشخیص بده حمید چه زمانی آمده، چه نوشیدنی می‌خواهد و نادیا چه کمکی پیشنهاد می‌دهد.
objective.en: Identify when Hamid moved in, which drink he wants, and what help Nadia offers.

turns.text: Hello, I think you are our new neighbor.

translation.fa: سلام، فکر می‌کنم شما همسایهٔ جدید ما هستید.
translation.en: Hello, I think you are our new neighbor.

gloss.en: are; be with you or we
new; recent or not used before

turns.text: Yes, I moved in yesterday, my name is Hamid.

translation.fa: بله، دیروز اسباب‌کشی کردم؛ اسم من حمید است.
translation.en: Yes, I moved in yesterday, my name is Hamid.

gloss.en: name; what a person is called
is; be with he, she or it

turns.text: I am Nadia, welcome to the building, how do you like it so far?

translation.fa: من نادیا هستم؛ به ساختمان خوش آمدید. تا اینجا نظرتان درباره‌اش چیست؟
translation.en: I am Nadia, welcome to the building, how do you like it so far?

explanation.fa: برای معرفی بگو I am Nadia. برای توصیف یک چیز از is و برای چند چیز از are استفاده کن. our یعنی مال ما و your یعنی مال شما.
explanation.en: Say I am Nadia to introduce yourself. Use is for one thing and are for more than one. Our means belonging to us; your means belonging to you.

example.text: The apartment is nice, but the boxes are still everywhere.

explanation.fa: moved in یعنی به خانهٔ جدید اسباب‌کشی کردم. yesterday نشان می‌دهد این اتفاق دیروز رخ داده و تمام شده است. در move، برای گذشته فقط d اضافه می‌شود.
explanation.en: Moved in means started living in a new home. Yesterday shows the move happened the day before today. Add d to move for this past form.

example.text: Yes, I moved in yesterday, my name is Hamid.

translation.fa: بله، دیروز اسباب‌کشی کردم؛ اسم من حمید است.
translation.en: Yes, I moved in yesterday, my name is Hamid.

takeaway.fa: moved in را با هم یاد بگیر.

explanation.en: Use Do you followed by an action: Do you need help? How do you like it so far? asks for an opinion about the experience until now.

translation.fa: من نادیا هستم؛ به ساختمان خوش آمدید. تا اینجا نظرتان درباره‌اش چیست؟

explanation.fa: I can help یعنی می‌توانم کمک کنم. That would be great راه مؤدبانهٔ قبول پیشنهاد است. I will bring it یعنی گوینده تصمیم می‌گیرد آن را بیاورد. پس از can، would و will، کار را به شکل ساده بیاور.
explanation.en: I can help offers help. That would be great politely accepts. I will bring it gives a decision to bring something. Use the plain action after can, would or will.

example.text: I will bring it in a minute, and I can help you with the heavy boxes.

translation.fa: تا یک دقیقهٔ دیگر می‌آورمش و می‌توانم برای جعبه‌های سنگین کمکتان کنم.

takeaway.fa: can help، would be و will bring را تمرین کن.
takeaway.en: Practice can help, would be and will bring.

explanation.fa: I have not had time to unpack yet یعنی «هنوز وقت نکرده‌ام وسایلم را باز کنم». not جمله را منفی و yet معنی «تا الان» را اضافه می‌کند. اینجا have not had را به‌عنوان یک الگوی آماده برای «هنوز وقت نداشته‌ام» یاد بگیر.
explanation.en: I have not had time to unpack yet means there has been no time for unpacking until now. Not makes it negative; yet means until now. Learn have not had time as a useful whole.

example.text: A cup of tea would be lovely, I have not had time to unpack yet.

translation.fa: یک فنجان چای خیلی خوب می‌شود؛ هنوز وقت نکرده‌ام وسایلم را باز کنم.
translation.en: A cup of tea would be lovely, I have not had time to unpack yet.

takeaway.en: Not ... yet means not until now.

explanation.fa: پس از Thank you for می‌توانی یک کار را با ing بگویی: being so kind یعنی این‌قدر مهربان بودن. for اینجا دلیل تشکر را نشان می‌دهد. I appreciate your help هم تشکر از کمک طرف مقابل است.
explanation.en: After Thank you for, an action can end in ing. Being so kind gives the reason for thanks. I appreciate your help is another way to thank someone.

example.text: That would be great, thank you for being so kind.

translation.en: That would be great, thank you for being so kind.

explanation.en: In a minute means after a very short time. A cup of tea is one cup; some tea is an amount of tea. But contrasts the nice apartment with the unpacked boxes.
